rows.en: Resh: "H-Hey! Is it all right to take the commander's machine
Barkin: "Hmph! He won't complain if I win.
You're the one who's in the way. Go back already!"
I can handle these guys on my own..."
Resh: "You're an idiot, but you're a good guy.
Resh: "You should learn to lie a little better."
Ai: "Touya. I'm doing things my way."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I can't trust you with my life yet.
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
Touya: "You think I'd die that easily?"
Yamato: "All right, all right. That's enough! We're in a battle!"
Touya: "Hey, don't go killing me off on your own."
Kasumi: "Are you all right? Are you hurt?"
Touya: "I'm fine. You think I'd die that easily?"
Fain: "Ah! You bastard! You made Kasumi cry!"
Touya: "Kasumi, I'm fine, so don't cry.
Besides, you're a Spirit Mech Pilot now."
I'll do my best for you, too, Touya-chan.
Touya: "What the hell is he talking about...?"
Is that really the same terrorist?!"
Ai: "Don't you know the rule that main characters
don't get beaten by small fry?"
Ai: "Now! Hah! The first strike wins!"
Touya: "Is this... Is this really something worth going this far for, even self-destructing
You can't... die before me... Damn!"
I'm not the sort of man who dies in a place like this."
Resh: "That had better be true! It had better..."
Can't you trust a friend's word?"
Resh: "!! H-Hey, what did you just say...?"
You're getting in the way of my moment of glory."
Resh: "...All right. But you'd better come back!
Resh: "Barkin! Get out of there! What are you going to do?!"
Barkin: "Resh, I'm counting on you to take care of the rest!"
Barkin: "Heh heh. This is about all I can do now...
You're going to look after them to the end!
I won't! I won't do it, no matter what!"
Barkin: "Heh heh. You're going to turn down a friend's request?"
Barkin: "Commander, I don't think I can return your machine...
I'm sorry... Demi, I'm sorry... Rii... Rudi..."
Barkin: "I won't let it end like this!"
Touya: "What is he going to do?!"
Yamato: "!! T-Touya, this is bad! That machine..."
Barkin: "Commander, I don't think I can return your machine...
I'm sorry... Demi, I'm sorry... Rii... Rudi..."

Kasumi fears Touya dead but he answers alive; alternate combat states not merged. Main-character rule is Ai genre taunt, not actual gameplay guarantee. Self-destruction only printed fictional combat, no construction/procedure. Barkin says friend and asks Resh retreat, not narrator guarantee he survives.
